Luxury came from 'European country-estate' wording, but this is a family-run, mid-priced venue, not a resort or destination estate. The site leans heavily on its gardens, gazebo and grape arbors, which fits the Outdoors (gardens) rule. With the corrected Description the rules give Classic (old-world) and, through 'gardens', Outdoors.
